name: @storagebase/deps
//: The fork's node-only SDK workspace (P8). Root package.json never gains a fork dependency; the root gets only the one-time "workspaces": ["packages/*"] seam. bun hoists these into the root node_modules, bun.lock carries the workspace, and knip.json lists this package with the SDKs as ignoreDependencies because their consumer (src/storagebase/**) sits in the root workspace. The Azure set is what the azure-blob and azure-key-vault providers load; @platformatic/kafka is already a root dependency upstream. scripts/storagebase/stage-resource-sdks.mjs stages this closure into the standalone Docker payload.
